- **Great simulator?** → infection; always in the differential
- **Old patient, sclerotic, bigger bone?** → Paget's disease vs sclerotic metastasis
- **Hand, expansile?** → enchondroma, giant cell reparative granuloma

| The examiner asks (Prof Abosena's Q&A) | Short answer |
|---|---|
| Causes of protrusio? | Osteomalacia, Paget, RA (rheumatoid arthritis), AS (ankylosing spondylitis), Marfan |
